sn37.18:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. katamehi pañcahi: saddho ca hoti, hirimā ca hoti, ottāpī ca hoti, amaccharī ca hoti, paññavā ca hoti. imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo
sn37.18:1.2: kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatīti.
